maria_pm: Quick sync — Q3 roadmap item: we need a concrete proposal for Dedicated preempt lanes + a bidding/credit model so enterprise customers can get predictable SLAs while letting non-critical traffic use cheaper capacity. Thoughts? :thinking:

kunal_eng: +1. We keep hearing customers ask for 'priority tiers' that don't require full reserved GPU capacity. Need the exact guarantees though — p50/p95 latency targets?

maria_pm: For enterprise tier: 150ms p50, 400ms p95 for short chat requests. For lower tiers: best-effort with bounded evictions (soft-preempt). That's the starting ask from 3 customers.

sara_runtime: Doable, but implementation options vary: (A) hard reservation with weighted queues, (B) preemptible slots with reclaimable cache, (C) bid-based lane where customers spend credits to jump queue. Each has perf tradeoffs.

tom_infra: Important: preemption must avoid KV cache loss for hot sessions. If we evict mid-conversation we blow p95. We should design soft-preempt that migrates KV cache if possible or fall back to a compatible smaller model.

chris_sre: Also need SLO burn rate tracking + automated rollback hooks. If preempt lane overload -> auto-fallback to hosted equivalent model or throttle. Observability must show which lane caused miss.

jess_sales: From deals: customers want a simple billing story. Credits model is OK as long as it's predictable monthly usage rather than per-request surprises. They asked for a cap and alerting when credit usage hits 80%.

maria_pm: Proposal sketch: three lanes — Reserved (dedicated, no preempt), Priority (preemptible but paid credits for guaranteed windows), Best-effort (free/cheapest, can be evicted). Priority users can top up credits; credits consumed per second of GPU time or per token.

kunal_eng: Implementation note: priority lane can be a weighted token bucket in router + admission control in scheduler. If credits exhausted, move to best-effort. We should simulate latencies with current load curves before committing to p95 numbers.

sara_runtime: Simulation needed. I'll add a load test that replays customer mixes (TL;DR: long-chat vs short-chat). Need to know expected KV hit ratios when migrations happen.

maria_pm: Action items: sara — run sims and report next Tues. kunal — draft scheduler admission logic doc and API for credits. tom — assess infra cost for hot-cache migration or fast model fallback. jess — confirm acceptable billing cadence with legal. chris — outline SLO alerting and rollback playbook.

ops_bot: Note: created task ticket #INF-2317 for scheduler draft, assigned to kunal_eng.

kunal_eng: One open question — do we let customers reserve 'soft bursts' (short guaranteed windows) rather than ongoing priority? That might be easier for capacity planning.

jess_sales: Many customers prefer scheduled bursts (product launches). If we support 'burst reservations' with advance booking + credit guarantee, it's a win.

maria_pm: Good call. Add burst reservations as a sub-feature of Priority. UX: reservation window, credits hold, and a fallback model if we fail to meet reservation (with credit refund policy).

chris_sre: For refunds we need deterministic failure modes. If failure is due to infra outage -> full refund + credit + postmortem. If failure due to exceeding contracted cap -> partial refund. Outline in SLA.

tom_infra: Also consider 'slot slicing' — split a GPU pool into soft-isolated lanes so best-effort can't thrash priority. That reduces absolute utilization but improves predictability. Need cost/KPI tradeoff sim.

sara_runtime: I'll include slot-slicing and kv-migration/fast-fallback heuristics in the sim matrix. Expect results in 2 cycles.

maria_pm: OK, timeline: by end of sprint we want: design doc (kunal), sims (sara), cost delta (tom), billing + contract language draft (jess), SLO playbook (chris). We'll reconvene next Wed 10am. :thumbsup:

kunal_eng: Filing notes: potential API changes — new header X-Redwood-Priority, /v1/credits top-up endpoint, and admin endpoints to reserve bursts. Will proto.

jess_sales: Also capture migration support for enterprise on-boarding (runbooks + run trial bursts). I'll draft an onboarding checklist.

maria_pm: Thanks team. If anyone gets blockers ping me. I'll update the roadmap board after we get the sims. :rocket:
